guitar.modelsText: Gibson Les Paul (Joe Perry has a Bone Yard signature) / Brad Whitford Gibson Les Paul
models: Gibson Les Paul (Joe Perry has a Bone Yard signature)
guitar.evidence: Trained knowledge: Joe Perry is famously a Gibson Les Paul player (Billie Perry / Boneyard signatures), Brad Whitford also plays Les Pauls.
guitar.notes: Original was reasonable; refined to emphasize Les Paul as primary for both, dropped Strat mention as less central.

tone.target: wah-soaked talkbox riff with dirty mid-gain crunch
tone.profile: wah-soaked talkbox riff with dirty mid-gain crunch
tone.summary: A crunchy, mid-gain signal chain utilizing a Boost/OD pedal to drive a UK 45 style amp into a vintage British cabinet, enhanced with Wah and moderate delay for depth.

blocks.purpose: Clean up ambient noise and hum.
Provide mid-gain crunch and boost the signal for dirty riff bite.
Simulate the essential wah vocal sweep for the talkbox effect.
Add dirty mid-gain crunch and sustain without heavy fuzz.
Model the classic Marshall crunch tone required for AC/DC era rock.
Provide the classic British cabinet sound.

blocks.purpose: Sculpt the tone by emphasizing mids for 'dirty riff bite' and talkbox clarity.

improvements.summary: Improve cabinet realism for a more authentic Marshall/British rock tone.

proposals.reason: Enhance the classic British crunch sound and dirty riff bite.
